summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature; nothing committed and no tests run, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod with docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with the spec's docstring caveats. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for title controls. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (byte assertion skipped when legacy_windows is set), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py using the mocked wrapper. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed under Unreleased with one bullet linking pull request 2200. Choice made: the changelog link uses the upstream Textualize/rich repository URL; adjust if your remote differs. Verification was by reading only; tests and mypy still need to be run.
